thread.title: Media blames Trump’s climate change policies for Hurricane Florence [Video]

title: Media blames Trump’s climate change policies for Hurricane Florence [Video]
text: Fox Business Videos • September 13, 2018 Marc Lotter, former special assistant to President Trump, discusses how The Washington Post said that President Trump is “complicit” for Hurricane Florence because of his views on climate change.
